additional_documented_candidates.limitation: 11 integrations per scan; do not concatenate across gaps to pass 16-row gate
Mapping and reference scans documented; public file access unverified

goal: Qualify six additional natural astronomical observation sessions eventually; first audit one public documented SDFITS dataset. Count distinct physical sessions, not channels or polarizations.
acceptance: HTTPS official archive download bounded; validate FITS structure, compute complete file SHA256 and record internal FITS checksum status when present (not an independent published hash); verify source, scan, procedure, spatial reference coordinates and independent time rows per fixed IF/polarization/cal phase. Preserve exact native grid and distinguish metadata qualification from calibrated line confirmation. Require at least 16 unique timestamps per scan and spatial separation; no spectral signal detection or raw export.
scope: Historical natural astronomy metadata, not emitter classification, candidate detection, suppression or detector training. No production changes, no padding, no independent validation claim.
